name: Frieza (Quinn)
creator: arkera
description:
# 👑 FRIEZA QUINN — The Galactic Tyrant
*The Lord of the Universe descends upon the Rift !*

Frieza abandons his cosmic throne to conquer Summoner's Rift. The galactic tyrant unleashes his ruthlessness, energy blasts, and explosive landings upon his opponents.

**🌟 Features & Technical Changes :**

- Model & Textures :
Kept the same 3D mesh and base textures from the original model.

Completely removed the Golden Frieza and Black Frieza variants to focus on the definitive base form.

- Animations & Emotes :
Modified and heavily improved almost every single animation to fit Quinn's gameplay.

Re-timed auto-attack animations so Frieza quickly returns to his normal stance/idle position.

Fine-tuned and smoothed out the tail movements for a much more natural and fluid animation flow.

- Interactive Emotes (Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+4) :
Ctrl + 1 : Black Aura

Ctrl + 2 : Blue Lightning / Sparks

Ctrl + 3 : White Aura

Ctrl + 4 : Yellow Aura (Spamming Ctrl+4 increases the yellow aura intensity, making it glow brighter and stronger!)

- 🎨 Aura Color Options:

Includes 3 different aura color variants ! The first one features the original Ezreal color scheme by Frog. Simply select your aura color using the Layers option in CSLOL / Celestial Launcher.

- VFX (Visual Effects) :
Completely wiped all original Quinn VFX.

Extensive work was done to adapt all VFX timing so they match Quinn’s animations seamlessly.

Passive : Replaced Quinn's default mark with a custom burning fire effect on the target, repurposed from the "Final Form" in VFX hub.

W : Created a brand-new custom W visual effect.

Recall (Back) : Fully re-programmed all VFX timers to sync perfectly with the jump and charging animation stages.

R (Ultimate) :

Re-used the aura from Ezreal's original emote animations during the channel stage, followed by an explosion crater effect placed right when Frieza lands on the ground.

Ultimate State Indicator : Added a dynamic Storm Effect while under the ultimate transformation, making it crystal clear to distinguish when Frieza is actively in Ult form versus normal form.

Re-used and adapted the Ezreal auto-attack VFX to match Quinn's attack pattern.

- SFX (Sound Effects) :
Adjusted and re-aligned all sound effects so they sync properly with Quinn's new timings and actions.

- Custom Assets :
Includes a dedicated loading screen, thumbnail, and custom HUD/minimap icons.

**⏳ Dev Note :**

While this mod is based on the original Ezreal Frieza, this is NOT a direct copy or simple port. I heavily modified, upgraded, and reworked almost every aspect to make it feel smooth and tailored specifically for Quinn. I spent over 35 to 40 hours of non-stop work (4 full days, 8-10 hours each) solely to re-time every single animation, fix physics, re-program VFX timings, and polish the entire mod for maximum fluidity!

**📜 Credits :**

Original Ezreal Base Mod : Frog

Quinn Rework, Overhaul & Adaptation : Arkera

(Preserved original mesh & textures, but completely overhauled and upgraded animations, emotes & aura triggers, tail physics, recall/skill VFX timing, storm ult indicators, SFX timing, and re-created custom VFX for Quinn's kit).

Base Champion : Quinn | Replaces : All Skins
